newsitem.title: LATVIA: DAUAGAVPILS CHAIN IN 312,620 LATS H1 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: DAUAGAVPILS CHAIN IN 312,620 LATS H1 PROFIT.

text.p: Daugavpils Chain factory registered a half-year profit of 312,620 lats on turnover of 4.64 million lats, the bourse said on Wednesday.
The factory had production costs of 3.49 million lats and sales expenses of 58,165 lats while its administrative expenses amounted to 492,342 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
Daugavpils' income from other business activites came to 31,114 lats and it wrote off long-term financial investments worth 42,366 lats and paid 65,421 lats in interest.
Daugavpils' profit before tax was 516,107 lats and it paid 226,173 lats in tax leaving the after-tax profit at 312,620 lats, the statement said.
The company's balance sheet total is 8.53 million lats and it has tangible assets worth 2.88 million lats.
